doc: Conformant-absence registry (SSOT). Cases whose conformance property is DUT BEHAVIOUR (it must emit a correct frame, or must not emit a prohibited one) rather than a comparison against an operator-supplied expected value. A --expect negative cannot fault a conformant DUT on these, so they carry NO NEG_ROWS entry; their guard's non-vacuity is structural (the named fail final exists and is reachable by a misbehaving DUT) and is empirically provable only on the DUT-mutation track. The `class` axis is the property type that determines which fault trips the guard (see docs/verdict_policy.md Section 6), grounded in the safety/liveness dichotomy and the ISO 9646 4-value semantics. Validated by tools/negative_coverage_audit.py.

classes.prohibited_emission: Silence (no such emission) is a conformant outcome for this stimulus; the named fail final fires iff the DUT emits a frame the protocol forbids here. A conformant DUT never emits it. Covers rejecting malformed input (no OK echo), declining an invalid/unknown subscribe (no Ack), and emitting in a state that forbids it (after stop, wrong phase).
classes.incorrect_emission: A conformant DUT does emit such a frame for this stimulus, and it must carry a protocol-mandated value; the named fail final fires iff the emitted frame carries a wrong value. Covers acking (not nacking) a valid subscribe, monotonic/wrapping session ids, response-payload content, and post-reset field values.
classes.liveness: DUT must emit Y; Y is binary present/absent with no wrong-value variant; its absence over the window is inconclusive (see docs/verdict_policy.md Section 2 clause 4) and there is no reachable fail final to validate.

SOMEIP_ETS_041.property: DUT must not return an OK echo to a UTF-16 request whose inner string-length prefix is truncated (Error Response or silent drop is conformant)

SOMEIP_ETS_043.property: DUT must not return an OK echo to a UTF-16 request carrying an odd byte before the null terminator (Error Response or silent drop is conformant)

SOMEIP_ETS_050.property: DUT must not return an OK echo to a UTF-8 request whose inner string-length prefix is truncated (Error Response or silent drop is conformant)
